text:
jamie: Heads up — saw a CPU spike in prod telemetry ingest starting ~1765432000. p99 exporter latency jumped from 120ms -> 950ms. Suspect route-metering change yesterday.
ops-bot: [alert] telemetry-exporter-high-cpu instance-id=i-09ab3f... cpu=92% p99=950ms
sara: interesting. did we change sampling windows or add extra attributes to spans in the rollout?
devon: we rolled out route-metering v2 at 1765430000 — it adds per-route meter spans for all requests, +2 spans per request. that's a lot at 150k rps.
jamie: +2 spans per request at that volume explains amplification. also saw batch sizes drop to 1-2 items in logs which kills throughput.
liam: what's exporter batching config? remind me.
sara: otlp_exporter batch_max_items=500 flush_delay_ms=50 max_queue_size=8192
maya: logs show flush_delay honored but max_batch_items stayed low because we have lots of small spans. per-span serialization cost increased.
devon: snippet of span payloads — they're small but numerous:
```json
{"trace_id":"...","name":"route.meter","attrs":{"route":"/api/x","status":200}}
```
jamie: proposal: enable sampling for route-meter spans only (probabilistic sampler ~1%) and re-run canary. can we do that via collector config immediately?
liam: yes, we can add a processor filter with match on name and probabilistic_sampler rate=0.01 — low-risk hotfix.
sara: +1, also let's try increasing max_batch_items to 2000 temporarily and bump flush_delay_ms to 150 to favor throughput.
maya: running a quick sim: removing the extra spans and increasing batch thresholds predicts p99 exporter latency -> ~180ms and CPU down ~55%.
ops-bot: deploy triggered by maya: samplers/route-meter-rollout patch (CI passed)
devon: prepping rollback and will add metrics: "metered_span_ratio" and "export_batch_size.p50"/"p99" so we can validate.
jamie: after deploy we'll watch CPU + p99 for 10m, if stable we'll keep sampling and open a design doc to move route meters to metrics instead of spans. :thumbsup:
liam: note for follow-up doc: cost model comparison (spans vs metrics), cardinality concerns, backfill strategy for historical dashboards.
maya: will post short perf graphs in #eng-platform in ~15m with before/after and exporter batch histograms.
sara: thanks team — nice quick triage, want to capture this as a template for future instrumentation rollouts.
